title: Immersive Cinema and Clear XR Feedback · v0.10.3
changes: Cinema now replaces the entire passthrough renderer with a fully opaque black stereo backdrop; a large, camera-aligned image and an accessible white Exit control are the only controls visible.
The selected original image is loaded into the cinema at preserved aspect ratio. A faint simulated reflective floor is displayed; the normal spatial cards and mascot are hidden until Exit.
Camera and action notices use one compact muted-green line below the pink camera hint. A silent microphone transcript shows only No speech once.
DESCRIBE forces an explicit Meta vision request when selected, reports provider errors in its bubble and in LOG, and no longer leaves a permanent Analyzing placeholder on failure.
Image-action menu angular size remains controlled when photos are brought close to the headset.
Mascot aligns its head along its actual 3D flight direction and reacts to two pointing rays, an open palm, a fist, and forward gestures.
No watcher modifications, arbitrary quotas, or automatically initiated paid requests.
